programme_name: Máster Universitario en Industria Global de la Música y el Espectáculo (Global Entertainment and Music Business) — GEMB
institution: Universitat Politècnica de València (UPV) / Berklee College of Music, Campus Valencia (centro adscrito)
notes: VERIFIED OFFICIAL in RUCT, código del título 4313420, Máster RD 1393/2007, MECES 3, rama Ciencias Sociales y Jurídicas, campo 'Industrias Culturales', 60 ECTS (22 obligatorios + 24 optativos + 14 TFM, 0 prácticas externas). Verificación 19/09/2012; Consejo de Ministros 20/09/2013; BOE 15/11/2013; plan de estudios BOE 22/07/2014; corrección BOE 23/04/2019; autorización Comunitat Valenciana 19/07/2013; Resolución Favorable Renovación Acreditación 24/05/2021 (previa 10/05/2017). RUCT detail: https://www.educacion.gob.es/ruct/estudio.action?codigoCiclo=SC&codigoTipo=M&CodigoEstudio=4313420 (accessed 2026-08-24). Delivered at Berklee Valencia as a UPV-adscribed centre. Berklee page states: 'all classes are taught in English'; one-year, three consecutive semesters (fall/spring/summer); 34/35 Berklee credits = 60 ECTS; three tracks: record labels, live entertainment, entrepreneurship. CONFLICT to log: Berklee's own accreditation page (https://www.berklee.edu/institutional-research-assessment/valencia-spain-campus-accreditation) frames the degree as a US NECHE-accredited Master of Arts 'accredited in Spain, in collaboration with the Universidad Politècnica de València' and cites a Berklee Valencia authorisation as 'Centro Superior Autorizado de Enseñanzas Artísticas de la Música' (Resolución 6844, 08/08/2012) — i.e. it reads as a US degree with Spanish oversight, whereas RUCT shows a full official UPV máster universitario. Students appear to receive BOTH. Fees NOT FOUND on the pages read (UPV programme page www.upv.es/titulaciones/MUIGME/ returns 404; UPV master list is JS-rendered). Non-EU surcharge NOT CHECKED. HIGH PRIORITY for the candidate: English-taught, official, PhD-access, and the single strongest music-industry fit in Spain.

programme_name: Máster de Formación Permanente en Industria Musical y Estudios Sonoros (MiMeS)
notes: Verified on UC3M's own domain (accessed 2026-08-24). Explicitly a 'Máster de Formación Permanente' = título propio under RD 822/2021, NOT a máster universitario oficial: no ANECA verification, not in RUCT, NO PhD access. 60 ECTS, 1 academic year, presencial (Madrid, Getafe/Leganés campus), language of instruction SPANISH. Fee stated EUR 5,900 for 2026/27. Entry: recommended degrees in audiovisual communication, journalism, business admin, sociology, sound engineering, art history, musicology, advertising, marketing; motivation letter, references, CV and interview. Note: UC3M is a PUBLIC university, but a formación permanente title is still non-official — public-scholarship eligibility is therefore doubtful and NOT verified.

institution: SAE Institute Spain (SAE Creative Media Education), Madrid and Barcelona — accredited by UDIMA

Two award routes stated on the page: 'Máster Profesional en Industria Musical acreditado por UDIMA' and 'Máster en Formación Permanente en Industria Musical acreditado por UDIMA (60 ECTS)', plus a 'Diploma Profesional emitido por SAE Creative Media Education'. UDIMA is a private online university; a 'formación permanente' award from it is a título propio, NOT a máster universitario oficial — no ANECA verification, no RUCT entry, NO PhD access. 12 months, 'los cursos son íntegramente presenciales' (fully in-person), campuses Madrid and Barcelona. Page states high proficiency required in BOTH English and Spanish. Fees NOT FOUND on the page read.
